Maybe the light there is just what you need to see things differently.

ACTION: I keep my eyes fixed on a particularly troubled section of graft near the edge of the grove, adjusting the grip on my pruning knife so that my attention is absorbed solely by the delicate process of excision and repair; I do not acknowledge the voice's comment or look toward the red tree in any way at all.
